specialRules.ruleFull: The warband hires no hired swords. The only models it may take on are the dramatis personae Im Abav Yub and Gaz Er Unga Og.

The warband suffers no movement penalty from the weather, and halves any Initiative reduction the weather table calls for (a reduction of 2 becomes 1, a reduction of 1 becomes none). Sight, shooting and hailstorms affect them as they affect anyone else.
No warrior in the warband may use a blackpowder weapon, even if a skill he has would otherwise let him.
Any warrior in the warband within 6" of the Chief may use his Leadership instead of his own.
The Shaman is a spell caster and uses Barbarian Shaman Magic. He starts with two spells, chosen at random.
When a Hunter rolls That Lad's Got Talent, the new Hero takes Shooting and Speed as his skill lists.
When a Warrior rolls That Lad's Got Talent, the new Hero takes Combat and Strength as his skill lists.

specialSkillsList.name: Experienced Fighter
specialSkillsList.description: He always strikes first in hand-to-hand combat, whoever charged.

specialSkillsList.name: Attack Howl
specialSkillsList.description: When he charges he adds +2 to his close combat to hit rolls that turn instead of the usual +1.

specialSkillsList.name: Master Shot
specialSkillsList.description: The range of any bow he uses is 6" longer.

specialSkillsList.name: Concealment (Albion Barbarians)
specialSkillsList.description: Any enemy must halve the range at which he can spot this warrior while he is hidden. He may also shoot while hidden: roll a D6 afterwards, and on a 5 or 6 he stays hidden.

flags.what: The warband's minimum of 3 models is not imported: our templates hold no minimum.

The PDF prints one equipment list for the whole warband and says the Warriors "use all kinds of weapons the tribe produces except bows", so the Bow line is read as closed to Warriors; every other line is open to all.
The list prints its Armor section with a Shield only. No other armour is sold.
Starting experience: Chief 20, Shaman 8, Champions 4, Henchmen 0.

Savage Fury is our Savage Fury, the Amazons' (+1 Attack when charging, immune to charm effects and fear), and merged into it (William, 12 Nov 2026: "keep as 1 add charm"): this group learns ours, which is reworded away from the Amazon, and this page's limit of the bonus to the first round of combat is dropped.
Concealment is kept apart as Concealment (Albion Barbarians): ours halves the spotting range in jungle terrain only and does not let him shoot while hidden. See the decisions.
The six Shaman spells are a new lore, Barbarian Shaman Magic, with the difficulties the PDF prints (6, 6, 7, 7, 5, 7).
